title: BPBond 솔로 #139 · 커브드바스트 · Japanese Kutani porcelain · 은 필리그리 세트 벽 구속 · moist rose-tinted lips
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Chinese woman in her late 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, clear fair skin, a warm rose-red wash blended across the outer corners of both eyes and drifting up toward the temples, the same flush spreading softly across the cheekbones and the bridge of the nose, slightly smudged, dewy highlights, soft brown-pink eyeshadow, large moist eyes with bright real catchlights and a faint glassy shine, moist rose-tinted lips, a dreamy, half-lidded expression, cool and composed, vivid copper-orange hair styled in braided, real living eyes. Long round nails, chrome finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Japanese Kutani porcelain — a cream-white ground with bold red, gold and green overglaze enamels, wide gold-and-red bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense overglaze florals filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Restraints: She wears a wide polished silver collar of openwork filigree, with a heavy silver ring at the front, snug around her neck, from which a heavy chain of chunky thick polished silver links, each link as thick as a thumb, runs to a large polished silver ring bolted into the stone wall at head height beside her. Her wrists wear wide polished silver cuffs of openwork filigree, each with a heavy silver ring, each ring linked by a short chain of the same chunky polished silver links, up and outward to its own large polished silver ring bolted into the stone wall high on its own side, her arms stretched fully straight in a wide V above her head. Her ankles wear wide polished silver cuffs of openwork filigree, each with a heavy silver ring, each ring linked by a short chain of the same chunky polished silver links, down and outward to its own large polished silver ring bolted into the base of the stone wall on its own side.

Pose: standing full height between the two walls, facing the camera, her arms stretched fully straight in a wide V above her head, her legs spread apart, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Footwear: Extreme gold-and-red plain stiletto pumps, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone, at least three times the thickness of an ordinary heel.

Background & Lighting: the dim torchlight and flickering light catching the painted pattern in sharp glints, carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide. portrait 2:3 vertical.
